title: ABOUT
body:
About Us

Nooney & Dowdall LLP is a firm of solicitors dedicated to providing you with legal advice, representation, & client service to the very highest standard.

MATTHEW JOHNSTON, Managing Partner

Our History

Founded in 1877, Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors continues to provide advice & representation to the highest standards.

Over 147 years later, our solicitors in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath enhance these core values when delivering results for clients. Evolving over time to continue to provide advice & representation to the highest standards.

Our Mission

Delivering professional advice & personal service to the highest standard, meeting & exceeding on clients expectations.

While based in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, we help clients across Ireland & many diverse parts of the world.

"Shane, thank you for looking after our affairs over the years - especially for your patience. You are a true professional."

DICK & CATHY (Mullingar)

Our Values

PERSONALISED CARE

Feel heard & valued. With us, you're not just another case; you're part of our family.

We listen, we understand, & we dedicate ourselves to addressing your unique needs.

ACCESS TO EXPERIENCE

Speak directly with the experts. At Nooney & Dowdall LLP, you're always the priority.

No middlemen, no runarounds, just expert advice whenever you need it.

TRUST & PEACE OF MIND

Stay informed at every stage. We believe in clear, honest communication.

You'll always know where you stand, what we're doing for you, & why.

BLOG ARTICLES

Clear, authoritative insights across different topics such as buying & selling property, drafting wills & handling road traffic claims.

Our articles provide the knowledge & confidence you need to make informed decisions when confronting legal issues.
